source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第十一课《大自然的语言》
file_note: The workbook's exercises for 第十一课, typed from 练习册A pp. 68–81 (PDF index = printed + 4, verified on p. 68). Same shapes as L03–L05: tf/order/slots/match/sort are marked by rule; write is judged stroke by stroke; free is grid writing for the chinese-review skill (where a free item has one right answer, its exercise carries a key_note for the reviewer); read and speak are recorded; the four-choice exercises are `blocks` naming zh-word items. The 第11课 listening script is in the appendix on pp. 83–84 (it runs over the page, not only 82–83). Left out: 星期五 练习2 (p. 80, 读一读, a dialogue of the workbook's own between 妈妈, 朵朵 and 小燕子 — a passage, held back as L03 held back 《故宫》; she reads it from the workbook). 星期五 练习1 (listening) and 练习3 are `pick` exercises; 练习3's item (2) is still out because the page does not settle its key (see that exercise's scope_note). 星期三 练习5 (p. 76, read the 课文 to a parent, who grades it and signs) is a `speak` exercise, as L12 has it; its shape_note says why it is not `read`. Two characters are also left out of the structure sort in 星期一 练习1 (言, 伞), though not out of the writing; that exercise's scope_note says why, and why 考 is keyed 半包围.

blocks.title: 选词填空
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks
blocks.scope_note: The book offers five characters (察 考 搬 伞 言) for four sentences, the third of which has two blanks (多观＿，多思＿). Items 1, 2 and 4 each carry four of the five in the box's order — the one left off is a character another sentence plainly needs — so the task she faces is the book's: which of the box completes this word. Item 3 keeps its sentence whole and asks for both blanks at once, with four pairs drawn from the box (the right pair, the same two swapped, and two pairs with one wrong), as z:L05-02 pairs a stroke count with a radical.

blocks.title: 找出不同类的词，涂上你喜欢的颜色
blocks.title_en: Find the odd words out and color with your favorite color
blocks.scope_note: Four rows of four words; she colors the one that is not the same kind as the other three. Each row is one four-choice item with the row's words in the book's order; the coloring is the tap.

blocks.title: 选词填空
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks
blocks.scope_note: Four words (丰富 晴天 观察 多么) for four sentences: each item carries all four, in the book's order.

exercises.title: 描一描，写一写
exercises.title_en: Trace and write

note.zh: 看旁边的词想字，用笔写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: The word beside the box tells you the character; write it with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

explanation.zh: 语言：yán。
explanation.en: 语言 — yán, language.

explanation.zh: 丰富：fēng。
explanation.en: 丰富 — fēng, rich, plentiful.

explanation.zh: 晴天：qíng。
explanation.en: 晴天 — qíng, a sunny day.

explanation.zh: 蚂蚁：yǐ。
explanation.en: 蚂蚁 — yǐ, ant.

explanation.zh: 搬家：bān。
explanation.en: 搬家 — bān, move house.

explanation.zh: 雨伞：sǎn。
explanation.en: 雨伞 — sǎn, umbrella.

explanation.zh: 观察：chá。
explanation.en: 观察 — chá, observe.

explanation.zh: 思考：kǎo。
explanation.en: 思考 — kǎo, think it over.

exercises.title: 左右结构、上下结构、半包围结构，还是独体字？
exercises.title_en: Left–right, top–bottom, half-enclosed, or a single-body character?
exercises.scope_note: The book lists the eight characters it has her write above four ruled lines: 左右结构, 上下结构, 半包围结构, 独体字. 考 is keyed 半包围: most dictionaries file it 上下, but the book prints a 半包围 line and 考 is the only one of the eight that can go on it, so the page settles what the book means (the same reasoning L07 used for 司 and L12 for 式). Two are left out because which line the book means cannot be read off the page, and a wrong key is worse than a missing item: 言 (filed as 独体字 by some references and as 上下结构 by others) and 伞 (likewise 独体字 or 上下结构 with 人 on top) — both of those lines are offered, so the page does not decide. 搬 is sorted 左右: strictly 扌·舟·殳 is 左中右, a group the book does not offer, and 扌 beside 般 is the left–right reading every classroom gives it. All eight are still written in zx:L11-D1-01w.

explanation.zh: 丰不能拆成两部分：独体字。
explanation.en: 丰 cannot be split into parts: a single-body character.

explanation.zh: 日在左、青在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 日 on the left, 青 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 虫在左、义在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 虫 on the left, 义 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 扌在左、般在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 扌 on the left, 般 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 宀在上、祭在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 宀 above, 祭 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 耂的长撇从左上方把丂包在里面：半包围结构。
explanation.en: The long 撇 of 耂 wraps 丂 from the top left: half-enclosed.

exercises.title: 数笔画，填空
exercises.title_en: Count the strokes and fill in the blanks

note.zh: 每句两个空：先写一共几画，再写那一笔叫什么（比如：横、竖、撇、点、横折）。
note.en: Two blanks in each: first how many strokes the character has, then the name of the stroke asked for (such as 横, 竖, 撇, 点, 横折).

exercises.key_note: Not marked by rule: the answer is a number and a stroke name written by hand, so it goes to the review skill. The keys, by the standard stroke order (GB 13000.1 笔顺): (1) 言 7 strokes, the 6th is 横折 (点 横 横 横 竖 横折 横); (2) 富 12 strokes, the 3rd is 横钩 (宀 = 点 点 横钩); (3) 伞 6 strokes, the 4th is 撇 (撇 捺 点 撇 横 竖); (4) 搬 13 strokes, the 12th is 横撇 (扌3 + 舟6 + 殳: 撇 横折弯 横撇 捺). Stroke counts checked against the vendored stroke data.

items.prompt_en: (1) How many strokes does 言 have, and what is its sixth stroke?
(2) How many strokes does 富 have, and what is its third stroke?
(3) How many strokes does 伞 have, and what is its fourth stroke?
(4) How many strokes does 搬 have, and what is its twelfth stroke?

exercises.title: 照例子写汉字，并组词
exercises.title_en: Follow the example to write characters and form words

note.zh: 例：亻＋门 → 们 → 你们。先在方格里写出两部分合成的字（写好了会显示标准写法），再用这个字组一个词。
note.en: Example: 亻 + 门 → 们 → 你们. First write in the box the character the two parts make (the standard form appears when you tap Done), then make a word with it.

items.prompt_en: 扌 + 般 → the character → one word
日 + 青 → the character → one word
宀 + 畐 → the character → one word
虫 + 马 → the character → one word
宀 + 祭 → the character → one word
忄 + 董 → the character → one word

exercises.order_note: The book lays the six out in two columns; they are taken row by row (扌+般, 日+青 / 宀+畐, 虫+马 / 宀+祭, 忄+董).

exercises.title: 连一连，组词语
exercises.title_en: Match to form words

note.zh: 先点上面的字，再点下面能和它组成词的字。课本已连好一组：语—言。
note.en: Tap a character on the top row, then the one below that makes a word with it. The book has drawn one line already: 语—言.

explanation.zh: 自—然：自然，大自然的"自然"。
explanation.en: 自 + 然 = 自然, nature, as in 大自然.

explanation.zh: 语—言：语言——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 语 + 言 = 语言, language — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 丰—富：丰富。
explanation.en: 丰 + 富 = 丰富, rich, plentiful.

explanation.zh: 细—心：细心，课文里说"细心观察"。
explanation.en: 细 + 心 = 细心, careful, as in the text's 细心观察.

explanation.zh: 观—察：观察。
explanation.en: 观 + 察 = 观察, observe.

exercises.title: 连一连，组词语：把词写下来
exercises.title_en: Match to form words: write the words

note.zh: 连线在前面做过了；这里把四个词各写一遍（课本已写好：语言）。
note.en: The matching was done on the site; here write each of the four words once (the book has written 语言 already).

items.prompt_en: 自 + 然 → the word
丰 + 富 → the word
细 + 心 → the word
观 + 察 → the word

exercises.title: 读一读
exercises.title_en: Read aloud

note.zh: 读出来，录下来就行，不打分。对照在批改的时候看。
note.en: Just read it aloud; it is recorded, not scored. The comparison is for the evaluation.

exercises.text:
观察 考察 懂得 懂事 易懂 听得懂

exercises.title_en: Match

explanation.zh: 有亭子、长椅和草地的地方是公园——图D。

exercises.title_en: Compare and form words

exercises.title: 连词成句
exercises.title_en: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：大自然也有语言吗？——课文一开头就这样问。
explanation.en: In order: 大自然也有语言吗？ — does nature have a language too? The question the text opens with.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：蚂蚁正在忙着搬家呢。
explanation.en: In order: 蚂蚁正在忙着搬家呢 — the ants are busy moving house.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：河里的冰化了。
explanation.en: In order: 河里的冰化了 — the ice in the river has melted.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：明天一定是个晴天。
explanation.en: In order: 明天一定是个晴天 — tomorrow is sure to be a sunny day.

exercises.title: 根据图片选择正确的句子
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct sentences for the pictures

note.zh: 图在练习册第73–74页。每组两句，一句对、一句错。
note.en: The pictures are on workbook pp. 73–74. Each pair has one true sentence and one false.

exercises.page_break_note: pairs (1)–(2) are on p. 73, (3)–(4) on p. 74

items.text: 朵朵正在开心地玩游戏。

explanation.zh: 图上朵朵拿着笔在本子上写字，不是在玩游戏。
explanation.en: In the picture Duoduo is writing in her exercise book with a pen, not playing a game.

items.text: 朵朵正在认真地写作业。

explanation.zh: 朵朵坐在桌子前，拿着笔写作业。
explanation.en: Duoduo sits at the table with a pen, doing her homework.

items.text: 乌龟正在不停地往前爬。

explanation.zh: 乌龟伸着四条腿往前爬，旁边没有吃的东西。
explanation.en: The tortoise has its legs out, crawling forward, and there is no food near it.

explanation.zh: 图上没有吃的东西，乌龟在往前爬。
explanation.en: There is no food in the picture; the tortoise is crawling along.

explanation.zh: 妈妈拿着吸尘器在打扫，就是在收拾房间。
explanation.en: Mother is cleaning with a vacuum cleaner — tidying the room.

explanation.zh: 妈妈手里是吸尘器，不是锅，她不是在做饭。
explanation.en: Mother is holding a vacuum cleaner, not a pan; she is not cooking.

explanation.zh: 小猫睁着眼睛，凑在饭碗旁边，没有睡觉。
explanation.en: The kitten's eyes are open and it is at its food bowl; it is not asleep.

explanation.zh: 小猫凑在装满食物的碗边，在吃东西。
explanation.en: The kitten is at a bowl full of food, eating.

exercises.title: 读课文，填一填
exercises.title_en: Read the text and fill

note.zh: 想想课文里是怎么说的，把缺的词写进格子里。
note.en: Think how the text puts it, and write the missing words into the cells.

exercises.key_note: The words the text has in each blank (课本 pp. 115–116): (1) 大自然, 丰富; (2) 搬家, 雨伞; (3) 细心; (4) 思考. The book's own sentence (3) prints commas where the text has 、; typed as the workbook prints it.

items.prompt: （1）人有语言，＿＿也有语言吗？有的，大自然的语言可＿＿了。
items.prompt_en: (1) 人有语言，＿＿也有语言吗？有的，大自然的语言可＿＿了。 (two words)

items.prompt: （2）你看，地上的蚂蚁正在忙着＿＿呢，天很快就要下雨了，你出门可要带上＿＿啊。
items.prompt_en: (2) 你看，地上的蚂蚁正在忙着＿＿呢，天很快就要下雨了，你出门可要带上＿＿啊。 (two words)

items.prompt_en: (3) 只有认真学习，＿＿观察，你才能看得见，听得懂。

exercises.title: 照例子，写句子
exercises.title_en: Follow the example to write sentences

note.zh: 例：①下雪了　②我们能堆雪人（只有……才……）→ 只有下雪了，我们才能堆雪人。图在练习册第75–76页。
note.en: Example: ① 下雪了 ② 我们能堆雪人 (只有……才……) → 只有下雪了，我们才能堆雪人。 The pictures are on workbook pp. 75–76.

exercises.key_note: Each has one answer, by the example: (1) 只有把水缸砸破，我们才能救出那个小朋友。 (2) 只有自己去试试，你才能知道河水是深是浅。 (3) 只有好好学习，你才能取得更大的进步。 — the book's ② has 可以, so 才可以取得更大的进步 is right too.

exercises.title: 把课文读给爸爸妈妈听，请他们评评分
exercises.title_en: Read the text aloud to your parents and ask them to grade

question.zh: 把《大自然的语言》读给爸爸妈妈听。读完请他们评评分：读得流利吗？有没有读错的字？
question.en: Read 大自然的语言 aloud to your parents. Then ask them to grade it: was it fluent, and were any characters misread?

note.zh: 课文在课本第115–116页，看着书读。读的时候会录下来；读完请爸爸妈妈评个分，再点一下"家长已听"。
note.en: The text is on textbook pp. 115–116; read it from the book. Your reading is recorded; afterwards have your parents give it a grade and tap Listened.

exercises.shape_note: Not `read`: a read exercise carries the text she reads, and the 课文 is held back (docs/chinese.md § 8). `speak` records her and takes the parent's tap as the 家长签名 the book asks for; the book's 评分 box has no field and is left to the parent to say. Shaped like L12's zx:L12-D4-04.

exercises.title: 猜字谜
exercises.title_en: Guess character riddles

note.zh: 读字谜，想出是哪个字，用笔写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: Read the riddle, work out the character and write it with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

exercises.page_break_note: riddles (1)–(2) are at the foot of p. 76, (3)–(5) at the top of p. 77

explanation.zh: 口在左，十在右：叶，树叶的"叶"。
explanation.en: 口 on the left, 十 on the right: 叶, as in 树叶, leaf.

explanation.zh: 大在上，可在下：奇，奇妙的"奇"。
explanation.en: 大 above, 可 below: 奇, as in 奇妙, wonderful.

explanation.zh: 大口框在外面，元在里面：园，公园的"园"。
explanation.en: The big 囗 frame outside, 元 inside: 园, as in 公园, park.

explanation.zh: 日在左，青在右：晴，晴天的"晴"。
explanation.en: 日 on the left, 青 on the right: 晴, as in 晴天, a sunny day.

explanation.zh: 又在左，见在右：观，观察的"观"。
explanation.en: 又 on the left, 见 on the right: 观, as in 观察, observe.

exercises.title: 根据课文判断正误
exercises.title_en: Decide whether the statements are true or false according to the text

items.text: 人有语言，但是大自然没有语言。

explanation.zh: 课文说：人有语言，大自然也有语言吗？有的，大自然的语言可丰富了。
explanation.en: The text asks whether nature has a language too, and answers yes — nature's language is very rich.

items.text: 河里的冰化了，地上的草绿了，树叶长出来了，这是夏天来了。

explanation.zh: 冰化了、草绿了、树叶长出来了，课文说这是春天来了，不是夏天。
explanation.en: Ice melting, grass turning green, new leaves: the text says that is spring arriving, not summer.

items.text: 地上的蚂蚁正忙着搬家呢，天很快就要下雨了。

explanation.zh: 课文说：蚂蚁正在忙着搬家呢，天很快就要下雨了。
explanation.en: The text says so: when the ants are busy moving house, rain is coming soon.

items.text: 只有细心观察，我们才能看得见、听得懂大自然的语言。

explanation.zh: 课文说：只有认真学习、细心观察，你才能看得见、听得懂。不细心观察，就看不见、听不懂大自然的语言。
explanation.en: The text says that only by studying hard and observing carefully can you see and understand; without careful observing you cannot read nature's language.

items.text: 大自然的语言又丰富又奇妙。

explanation.zh: 课文说：大自然的语言多么丰富、多么奇妙啊！
explanation.en: The text says it: how rich and how wonderful nature's language is!

exercises.title: 将图片和句子进行匹配
exercises.title_en: Match the pictures to the sentences

note.en: The four pictures are on workbook p. 78, lettered A to D. Tap a sentence, then the picture it describes. The book has filled in sentence (1): D.

left: 白云飘在高高的蓝天上，明天一定是个晴天。

explanation.en: A crowd of ants carrying a leaf — picture C.

items.left: 地上的草绿了，树叶长出来了，这是春天来了。

explanation.zh: 树枝上长出了新叶子——图A。
explanation.en: Branches putting out new leaves — picture A.

items.left: 天很快就要下雨了，你出门可要带上雨伞啊。

explanation.zh: 小女孩打着雨伞——图B。
explanation.en: The girl holding an umbrella — picture B.

exercises.title: 选择相应的句子补全对话
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct sentences to complete the dialogue

note.zh: 对话里缺了四句，按对话的顺序选。图在练习册第78页：一卷古代的纸。
note.en: Four lines are missing; choose them in the dialogue's order. The picture on workbook p. 78 is a roll of ancient paper.

exercises.page_break_note: the four choices and the picture are at the foot of p. 78, the dialogue at the top of p. 79
options: 纸张是由树木等原料做的。
朵朵，你也要多看多思考，说不定也能成为一个发明家。
我知道，这是古代的纸张。

items.before: 妈妈：朵朵，你知道这是什么吗？　朵朵：______

explanation.zh: 妈妈问"这是什么"，朵朵答：我知道，这是古代的纸张。
explanation.en: Mother asks what this is; Duoduo answers: 我知道，这是古代的纸张。

items.before: 妈妈：你真棒，那你知道纸张是由什么做的吗？　朵朵：______

explanation.zh: 问纸是由什么做的，答：纸张是由树木等原料做的。
explanation.en: Asked what paper is made from, she answers: from trees and other materials.

items.before: 妈妈：那你知道纸张是哪个国家发明的吗？　朵朵：______

explanation.zh: 问哪个国家发明的，答：纸张是中国发明的。
explanation.en: Asked which country invented it, she answers: China.

explanation.zh: 朵朵三个问题都答对了，最后妈妈鼓励她：你也要多看多思考，说不定也能成为一个发明家。
explanation.en: Duoduo has answered all three questions, so the last line is Mother's encouragement: look and think more, and you may become an inventor too.

exercises.title: 根据录音回答问题
exercises.title_en: Listen and answer the questions

note.zh: 先请爸爸妈妈读一读练习册第83–84页附录里第11课的听力文本（或放录音），听完再选。
note.en: First ask a parent to read the Lesson 11 listening script in the workbook appendix, pp. 83–84, aloud (or play the recording), then choose.

explanation.zh: 方方一开口就说想明天去公园玩儿。
explanation.en: Fangfang starts by saying she wants to go and play in the park tomorrow.

explanation.zh: 妈妈问要是下雨怎么办，方方说：不会的。
explanation.en: Mother asks what if it rains, and Fangfang answers that it won't.

options: 因为白云高高地飘在蓝天上

explanation.zh: 方方让妈妈看：白云高高地飘在蓝天上。录音里没有说到蚂蚁。课文也说，白云飘在高高的蓝天上，明天一定是个晴天。
explanation.en: Fangfang points to the white clouds floating high in the blue sky; the recording never mentions ants. The text says the same: white clouds high in the blue sky mean a sunny day tomorrow.

items.text: （4）方方是怎么知道这个知识的呢？
options: 因为方方刚学了《大自然的语言》

explanation.zh: 方方说，老师今天刚刚讲了《大自然的语言》。录音里没有说她爱看书。
explanation.en: Fangfang says her teacher taught 大自然的语言 just today; the recording says nothing about her loving books.

exercises.title: 根据上文选择正确的答案
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct answers according to the dialogue above

note.zh: 先读练习册第80页的对话（练习2），再选。
note.en: First read the dialogue on workbook p. 80 (exercise 2), then choose.

exercises.scope_note: The book's item (2), 妈妈让朵朵怎么做？ (A 快点回家 B 上网查找 C 问问小燕子), is left out: in the dialogue 妈妈 says both 快回家吧 and 你去问问他们吧, and the page does not say which the question means. The dialogue itself (练习2, p. 80) is a passage of the workbook's own and is not typed; she reads it in her book.
exercises.page_break_note: items (1)–(2) are at the foot of p. 80, (3)–(4) at the top of p. 81

explanation.zh: 对话里括号中写着：朵朵正准备回家，看到一群飞得很低的燕子。对话里没有蝴蝶，也没有花。
explanation.en: The stage note after Mom's first line says Duoduo, about to go home, sees a flock of swallows flying very low; there are no butterflies or flowers in it.

explanation.zh: 小燕子说：我们在捉虫子啊！虫子的翅膀沾了水汽飞不高，燕子要吃虫子，就得飞得低一些。
explanation.en: The swallow says they are catching insects: damp air weighs the insects' wings down, so the swallows fly low to eat them.

options: 小燕子低飞是要下雨了

explanation.zh: 对话讲的是下雨前空气很湿，虫子飞不高，所以小燕子低飞就是要下雨了。对话里没有说到蛇。
explanation.en: The dialogue explains that before rain the air is damp and insects fly low, so low-flying swallows mean rain is coming. It says nothing about snakes.

exercises.title: 说一说你知道的自然现象和天气小常识
exercises.title_en: Tell about general knowledge of natural phenomena and climate that you know

question.zh: 你知道哪些自然现象和天气小常识？
question.en: What do you know about natural phenomena and the weather?

note.zh: 例：（1）什么时候天晴？（2）什么时候会下雨？（3）冬天来了是什么样子？说一说，录下来，再请爸爸妈妈点一下"家长已听"。
note.en: For example: (1) When is the weather fine? (2) When will it rain? (3) What is it like when winter comes? Tell it and it is recorded; then have a parent tap Listened.

exercises.scope_note: The heading asks her to tell (说一说, "Tell about"), so it is a speak exercise as the contract maps 说一说; the book also rules six lines under the three example questions, so a teacher may want it written as well — a `free` item of two blanks of 40 cells would take that.
